subject: Acceptance walkthrough & audit-log handoff for Sterling Bank VPC deployment
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: lisa.ng@sterlingbank.com, infra-oncall@sterlingbank.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acceptance walkthrough & audit-log handoff for Sterling Bank VPC deployment

Hi Lisa / Sterling infra team,

Thanks again for the partnership on the VPC/on-prem deployment. Per our schedule, we'd like to run a final acceptance walkthrough and hand off the required audit artifacts so your compliance team can sign off. Proposed plan (30–45m):

- 08:30–08:40: High-level checklist review (runbook, ACLs, routing)
- 08:40–09:00: Live smoke tests (traffic mirror + sample requests)
- 09:00–09:15: Audit-log export verification & delivery method
- 09:15–09:30: Next steps / signoff items

What we'll bring: runbook stub (sterling_runbook_v1.3.pdf), smoke test harness, and an export of the audit logs for the final 24h window. We can deliver logs via secure SFTP or an encrypted transfer link — please confirm your preferred method.

Attaching the runbook stub for the walkthrough.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: sterling_runbook_v1.3.pdf
From: Lisa Ng <lisa.ng@sterlingbank.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: infra-oncall@sterlingbank.com, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance walkthrough & audit-log handoff for Sterling Bank VPC deployment

Thanks Aisha — that agenda looks good. A couple of compliance asks before we start:

1) We need a checksum and manifest for any audit-log export (SHA256).
2) Can you confirm the KMS key IDs used for signing/log encryption and whether they are customer-managed (HSM)?
3) We'll have two folks from compliance observe the live smoke tests. Please plan for a short window to run a sample query that demonstrates data isolation and redaction behavior.

Preferred delivery: sftp.sterling-secure.net (we will share credentials on the call).

Lisa Ng
Sr. Manager, IT Compliance — Sterling Bank
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: lisa.ng@sterlingbank.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance walkthrough & audit-log handoff for Sterling Bank VPC deployment

Hi Lisa,

Short answers ahead of the walkthrough:
- Audit-log export will include a SHA256 manifest file alongside the tarball; filename: audit-log-export-20270630.tar.gz + audit-manifest-20270630.sha256.
- KMS: The production environment uses your customer-managed key KMS-GCP-STERLING-01 (HSM-backed). Logs are encrypted in transit and at rest; signing is performed with the linked HSM key.
- Network/routing: All public egress is through the permitted NAT gateway; ACLs and VPC routes reviewed in section 3 of the attached runbook. ACLs in place: allow-list for Sterling subnets only, deny-by-default elsewhere.

Smoke test brief:
- Traffic mirror configured for sample prefix 10.45.0.0/24 -> mirror collector in staging for 20 minutes prior to live cutover.
- KV cache warmup: we will run the warmup for 2 hours (priming top-500 prompts) and sample 100 inference requests to verify tail-latency distribution.

I've uploaded a short checklist and a one-page network diagram to the runbook link (Drive). Will attach smoke-results after the run.

Attachments: network-security-checklist.pdf (excerpt), audit-manifest-20270630.sha256

- Marcus
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, lisa.ng@sterlingbank.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 07:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance walkthrough & audit-log handoff for Sterling Bank VPC deployment

Morning team — quick operational notes for the smoke window tomorrow (2027-06-30):

- Smoke window: 09:00–09:30 PT 
- Test cases (ordered): connectivity probe (ICMP/TCP), authenticated inference call (sample prompt), live-kv cache hit rate check, auditing pipeline end-to-end (generate event -> collector -> export).
- Success thresholds: 95% of sample inference requests < 120ms p95; audit export contains all event types for the window with no missing sequence numbers; checksum verification succeeds.
- Rollback criteria: any of the above fails AND manual approval from Sterling compliance + Redwood SRE.

I'll own running the test harness; Marcus will collect telemetry and deliver the csv results. Please be on the bridge at 08:50 so we can start on time.

Tessa Morgan
Platform Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Ng <lisa.ng@sterlingbank.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: infra-oncall@sterlingbank.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance walkthrough & audit-log handoff for Sterling Bank VPC deployment

Thanks — confirming Sterling compliance will join the 09:00 PT bridge. We will provide SFTP credentials the morning of the export. A few notes from our side: please include the system time drift report in the export (we audit NTP sync) and include a short summary of ACL changes in the manifest.

Also: we'll want the export delivered on the same day as the smoke run; if possible, please push the tarball to sftp.sterling-secure.net/inbound/redwood/ and send the manifest over the bridge chat.

Lisa
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: lisa.ng@sterlingbank.com, infra-oncall@sterlingbank.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance walkthrough & audit-log handoff for Sterling Bank VPC deployment — post-run summary

Team — post-run summary and artifacts (short):

- Bridge: 2027-07-01 09:00 PT — Sterling compliance + infra observed live smoke tests.
- Smoke results: all test cases met thresholds. p50/p95 for sample inference calls: 18ms / 88ms. KV cache hit rate: 96.2%. Detailed CSV attached: smoke-results-20270630.csv.
- Audit export: uploaded to sftp.sterling-secure.net/inbound/redwood/ as audit-log-export-20270630.tar.gz. Manifest and checksum: audit-manifest-20270630.sha256 (attached). System time drift report included in the tarball.
- Outstanding items: Sterling compliance requested a signed attestation doc; Marissa will coordinate DocuSign (INF-2345).

Thanks everyone for the quick coordination — marking this item as "ready for customer signoff".

Attachments: smoke-results-20270630.csv, audit-log-export-20270630.tar.gz, audit-manifest-20270630.sha256

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
